title: Baby Resting in Vintage Pram Outdoors, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a baby resting inside a dark folding pram or baby carriage outdoors on a grassy lawn with clover. The infant reclines against a lace-trimmed pillow and soft bedding, looking calmly upward toward the camera. The deckle-edged print reflects classic mid-20th-century domestic family photography celebrating early childhood and quiet moments in the backyard.
